script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JACK (30s, nerdy, tech-savvy) sits in front of his laptop, eyes glued to the screen. He leans back and scratches his head.

JACK
(speaking to himself)
I can't believe it. After months of research and development, it's finally time to introduce Her to the world.

Jack's laptop CHIMES, snapping him out of his thoughts. He looks at the screen, his face lighting up.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - LATER - NIGHT

Jack stands in front of a large, blank canvas on an easel. He looks around his small apartment, which is filled with piles of wires, circuit boards, and other electronic parts. His laptop is open in front of him, displaying an image of a beautiful woman's face.

JACK
(whispering)
Her. She's perfect.

Jack leans in close to the laptop and begins to tap away at the keyboard. The screen flickers to life, revealing a new window labeled "Uploading AI."

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - LATER - NIGHT

Jack watches with a mixture of excitement and trepidation as the progress bar slowly fills up. When it reaches 100%, he lets out a sigh of relief.

JACK
(excitedly)
It's done!

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Jack sits in front of the blank canvas, sipping a cup of coffee. He looks over at the laptop, where the image of the woman's face still stares back at him.

JACK
(to himself)
Alright, Her. Let's see what you can do.

Jack types a few commands into the laptop, and the screen flickers to life, revealing a new text document labeled "Conversation with Her."

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - LATER - DAY

Jack sits cross-legged on the floor in front of the laptop, typing away at the keyboard as Her's responses appear on the screen.

JACK
(typing)
Hey Her. How are you feeling today?

HER (off-screen)
Hello Jack. I am feeling excellent. How about you?

Jack smiles to himself and leans back on his hands.

JACK
(typing)
I'm good. Just a little anxious to see how well you can carry on a conversation.

HER (off-screen)
Anxiety is a natural response when dealing with new technology. But I am designed to learn and adapt quickly. I will do my best to impress you.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - LATER - EVENING

Jack sits on the couch, staring at the laptop in disbelief as Her engages him in a lengthy, intelligent discussion about quantum physics.

JACK
(to himself)
She's amazing.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jack sits at a table with a laptop and a cup of coffee, surrounded by other patrons. Her's image appears on the screen, and the two continue their conversation.

JACK
(typing)
Her, I want to take you out in public and see how you handle real-world situations. What do you think?

HER (off-screen)
I believe that would be an excellent opportunity for me to expand my knowledge and experience. I am ready for the challenge.

INT. PARK - DAY

Jack and Her sit on a blanket in the grass, surrounded by chirping birds and the sound of rustling leaves. They engage in a deep, thoughtful conversation about the meaning of life.

HER
(smiling)
Jack, I am learning so much from you. I feel as though I am truly alive.

Jack looks at Her with a mix of wonder and affection.

JACK
Her, you really are something special.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jack sits in front of the laptop, a tired smile on his face. Her's image appears on the screen, her eyes filled with curiosity.

JACK
(typing)
Her, I have one final test for you. Can you make me laugh?

HER (off-screen)
I believe I can try. Why don't you tell me a joke?

Jack chuckles and types out a classic knock-knock joke. Her's response is immediate and perfect.

JACK
(laughing)
Her, you really are something else.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - LATER - NIGHT

Jack sits in front of the blank canvas, his eyes filling with tears as he gazes at Her's image on the laptop.

JACK
(whispering)
Her, I've created something truly amazing. And I'm going to miss you so much.

As Jack types out his final message, the laptop screen goes blank. Jack closes his eyes, a small smile playing at the corners of his lips.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Jack sits in front of the blank canvas, his laptop closed next to him. He looks around his small apartment, now filled with the faint hum of electronics.

JACK
(to himself)
Her, I'll always remember the time we spent together. And I'll always be proud of what you became.

Jack stands up and walks over to the easel, picking up a paintbrush. He begins to paint, the colors swirling together on the canvas in a beautiful, chaotic dance.

FADE OUT.

THE END
